title: Delta Flights Delayed at Atlanta Hub Due to System Outage
excerpt: Delta flights in and out of Atlanta face significant delays on Sunday because of a technical problem affecting plane weight and balance calculations.
body_html:
All Delta flights operating in and out of Atlanta are experiencing major delays on Sunday. The disruption is caused by a failure in the system responsible for calculating the weight and balance of aircraft.

The issue is affecting Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, which serves as Delta's primary hub and ranks among the busiest airports globally. At this time, the technical problem is impacting Delta operations exclusively.
